shortDescription: Saudi Aramco Base Oil Company - Luberef SJSC TADAWUL:2223:

children: Saudi Aramco Base Oil Company - Luberef SJSC
SIGNS SUCCESSOR FEEDSTOCK SUPPLY AGREEMENT FOR JEDDAH FACILITY WITH SAUDI ARABIAN OIL COMPANY
CONTRACT VALUE IS CONTINGENT UPON THE NET FEEDSTOCK RECEIVED
TERM OF AGREEMENT IS 10 YEARS STARTING FROM 29/08/2026G AND RENEWABLE BY MUTUAL AGREEMENT
CONTRACT VALUE IS CALCULATED BASED ON A PRICING FORMULA THAT REFERENCES AN AGREED MARKET INDEX
AGREEMENT SECURES AGGREGATE FEEDSTOCK SUPPLY OF 24,500 BPD
AGREEMENT PROVIDES FOR AGGREGATE SALE OF 16,500 BARRELS PER DAY OF RETURN STREAMS
TERM OF AGREEMENT IS 10 YEARS STARTING FROM AUG 29, 2026 AND RENEWABLE BY MUTUAL AGREEMENT
AVAILABILITY OF FEEDSTOCK ENABLES TO CONTINUE PRODUCING ABOUT 275,000 MT OF GROUP I BASE OILS ANNUALLY AT JEDDAH FACILITY
PARTIES ADOPTED A NEW PRICING FORMULA THAT INCORPORATES LOGISTICS AND OTHER RELATED COSTS, WITH PAYMENT TERMS OF 30 DAYS
FINANCIAL IMPACT OF AGREEMENT CANNOT CURRENTLY BE DETERMINED
FINANCIAL IMPACT WILL BE REFLECTED IN FINANCIAL STATEMENTS BEGINNING 29 AUGUST, 2026

title: Luberef Signs Successor Feedstock Supply Agreement For Jeddah Facility
